name: io.github.tonyyang0504/lulu-mcp
description: Lulu Print API (Lulu Direct) (cross-ref lulu_print_api in Books & media) (ecommerce suppliers): me,

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_LULU_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client key of your Lulu Print API account (developers.lulu.com > API Keys); sent with the secret as HTTP Basic on the client-credentials token request.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_LULU_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client secret from the same page. Sandbox keys belong to https://api.sandbox.lulu.com, which this server does not switch to.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_LULU_CONTACT_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: contact_email sent with create_order (required by POST /print-jobs/): who Lulu contacts about the Print-Job.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_LULU_ENV
environmentVariables.description: Vendor environment (default production): sandbox = https://api.sandbox.lulu.com. Credentials are the environment's own; see adapter.environments in the catalog entry.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_LULU_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional https base URL override (a mock or a private gateway); replaces the selected environment's base_url. Never echoed in errors.
